hypothesisMarkdown:
## CSS unrolling copies each value once Hypothesis

Unrolling a CSS animation copied each iteration's stops and then copied every value again into its keyframe (the first copy kept as the last value an iteration ended with). Each keyframe now takes its copy; the last value is read back from the last keyframe where a fill needs it.\n\n**Tested mechanism:** one copy a keyframe. **Allowed:** svg `animate::unroll`. **Forbidden:** value sharing types.
